patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring a high-quality video background with text overlay, establishing a premium feel.
Alternating dark and light background sections to visually segment content, with dark sections often featuring product imagery or testimonials.
Prominent, bold sans-serif typography for headings, creating strong visual impact and clear hierarchy against a clean background.
A high-contrast palette of deep darks (black/charcoal) and crisp whites/light greys, accented by a distinct, vibrant teal-green for calls to action.
The hero background video exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections and individual content blocks appear to reveal with a fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scroll.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a full-width video as a background element, overlaid with a dark gradient or tint to ensure text legibility. This video background is then linked to scroll, creating a subtle parallax effect where it moves at a different rate than the foreground content.
A sticky navigation bar remains at the top of the viewport, maintaining brand presence and access to key links throughout the user's journey.

Content sections and individual elements within them are designed to animate into view as the user scrolls, typically with a fade-up or slide-in motion, enhancing engagement and guiding attention through the page content. This is likely managed by an 'animate-on-scroll' library.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body text) create strong visual anchors, complemented by a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and some image containers, maintaining a modern yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a sense of openness, while product grids are more compact.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a high-quality, full-bleed video hero with subtle parallax immediately conveys a premium and dynamic brand image. This, combined with a minimalist, high-contrast aesthetic and strong product photography, elevates it beyond a generic template.
